landing.returningDetail: Start with your existing hospital details.

consent.title: Your permission
consent.explanation: We will collect only the information needed to prepare your visit for the doctor. You can choose what you agree to.

collected.title: What information will be collected
collected.body: Your basic details, health concerns, history, and any documents you choose to upload.

used.title: How this information will be used
used.body: It helps create a clear intake summary and identify urgent warning signs for your care team.

never.title: What will never happen
never.body: AI will not diagnose you, write automated prescriptions, or sell your data. Doctor remains in full control of diagnosis and treatment.

history_collection.title: Collect my health history
history_collection.detail: Ask questions about my concern and past health.

document_processing.title: Process my health documents
document_processing.detail: Read reports or prescriptions I choose to upload.

data_sharing.title: Share with my care team
data_sharing.detail: Let the hospital team use this intake for my visit.

mode.title: Select Department
mode.subtitle: AYUSH mode includes traditional history-taking such as Prakriti, Vikriti, and Agni.
